biggest_catch: You must buy the caregiver membership before applying to a single job — it's a real upfront cost, and third parties report roughly $34.95/year, so the 'free to join' headline only covers browsing.
upfront_fee: Membership required to apply for jobs (official page confirms; amount not published on the page — third parties report ~$34.95/year).

weasel_words.quote: 'Earn an average of $125 + tips per job' — an average, not a guarantee; new sitters earn less while building reviews.

repeatable.cadence: Apply for jobs on the Job Board, complete the booking, and get paid instantly after each one — repeat daily, with recurring nanny gigs as the stable version of the loop.

maximize: Complete the membership and background check now so you're bookable today; set your opening rate at the local average to win first jobs, then raise it as reviews land; favor recurring nanny gigs over one-offs for stable income; pet-sitting and senior-care listings often have less competition than babysitting; respond to new job alerts within minutes — the fastest applicant usually wins.
who_pays: The families pay you — you keep 100% of your booking payments with no cut taken by UrbanSitter, and payouts land instantly right after each job.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older (younger sitters have limited options), create a full caregiver profile with your experience and availability, buy the annual caregiver membership, and clear the background check (through Checkr). References and a cleared check boost your bookings.
work_available: You apply to jobs on the Job Board, but new sitters compete head-to-head with established, reviewed sitters for the same families — expect a slow start. Demand is metro-dependent, and suburbs can be thin.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid instantly after each completed job, and you set your own rates. Reviews drive everything — sitters report being removed for minor infractions, and UrbanSitter reserves the right to hide or remove profiles that don't meet its requirements. The exact strike and removal thresholds are not publicly stated.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Cost warning: a paid caregiver membership is required before you can apply to a single job, but UrbanSitter does not publish the fee on its official pages — its own blog only calls the annual fee 'less than the cost of one fancy latte a month' and non-refundable, while reported figures conflict ($24.95 vs $34.95/year). The membership includes the required background check at no extra stated cost. Unpaid time: building your profile, waiting for bookings, and travel to families' homes.
when_cash_arrives: Instant payouts right after each job, per UrbanSitter's official page — genuine same-day money (one independent reviewer notes credit-card payments can take a few days to reach you by direct deposit).
